tool_contract.instructions: Inspect the learner-readable repository. Submit one complete unified diff when public evidence determines a change. The neuronal <stop> choice is terminal and neutral. Acceptance returns only a conclusion unless a reviewer provides new public text.
tool_contract.learner_readable_files: the exact task mount allowlist, including public tests
tool_contract.patch_hashing: the runner computes sha256 from the submitted UTF-8 diff
tool_contract.patch_paths: canonical repository-relative POSIX paths from the writable source allowlist; tests, configuration, additions, deletions, renames, modes, binaries, absolute paths, and traversal are rejected
tool_contract.writable_files: existing Python files inside the repository package
